decisions.collectorChecklist: One Base collector checklist of 720; no series split. Retain complete 15-card Tim Salmon checklist, explicitly flattening availability of mail-in-only #13-15 in VCS rather than fragmenting a single collector set.
decisions.scope: 940 standard-size cards across 14 collector sets. Include all 12 Tim Salmon autograph numbers, the physical All-Rookie redemption, and genuine jumbo-channel inserts. Exclude separate Fleer Update, Sunoco, Ultra, promotional samples/sheet, oversized Golden Moments 3x5 and the separately mailed All-Rookie Team M1-M9 set. No verified base parallel issue.
decisions.rookies: Only explicit base RC tags, matched to the separately retrieved TCDB rookie index, receive RC. Rookie Sensations, Major League Prospects, awards and exchange titles are not true-RC evidence. #669 Pedro Martinez is the Padres pitcher, distinct from Dodgers #515.
decisions.teamData: Keep source-confirmed historical teams, including composite teams and teams printed on base checklists. Base checklist #720 and the generic All-Rookie redemption have no team. Only redemption is a non-checklist blank; review.teamData PENDING requires --allow-pending-teams, never an invented MLB team.
decisions.pack: 15 total cards per standard foil pack, 36 packs/box. Physical one-insert-per-pack collation cannot be guaranteed by current VCS independent ProductSet rolls. Retain verified family ratios; do not merge separate collector checklists to force a guaranteed slot. Pack/release QA remains pending.
decisions.channelOdds: Golden Moments was one per blue retail jumbo; Lumber Company one per 5 hobby jumbo; Rookie Sensations one per 4 hobby jumbo. Unknown channel shares cannot be inferred from card counts or pack sizes: odds remain null in this standard product. Autograph odds likewise unknown. Null families import for pricing/images but cannot be pulled until Admin configures odds.
decisions.autographPrintRun: Tim Salmon signed 2000 cards total across twelve card numbers. Do not assign SN2000 or PR2000 to each individual card; authenticity embossing is the card-specific distinction.
decisions.leagueLeaders11: Tom Glavine is checklist position 11 of 12 but the number is missing from the printed card; retain collector ID 11 with UER metadata.
decisions.release: Product created unreleased. Pricing, pack/card images, insert/pack collation QA and release pending.
